## 🛠️ Project Tasks: "Fine-Tuned + RAG Assistant with an Eval Harness"
- [ ] Fine-tune an open-weight model (Llama 3 or Mistral 7B) using QLoRA on a domain-specific dataset
- [ ] Build a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline over a target document corpus using Chroma or Weaviate
- [ ] Build a custom evaluation harness using `lm-evaluation-harness` or a rubric-based grading loop
- [ ] Benchmark outputs across 3 axes: faithfulness, relevance, and hallucination rate

## 🏁 Operational Checkpoint
- [ ] **Verification:** Can you show, with a clear numerical metric, why RAG helped (or did not help) compared to fine-tuning the model alone?
